title: Portuguese Youth Creates ChatGPT Version for Crimes According to Reports
description: Recent reports indicate a young Portuguese person created a version of ChatGPT used for crimes, leading to FBI involvement.

sections.heading: Development of the AI Tool
paragraphs: According to Público, a young Portuguese autodidact created a version of ChatGPT that was used for crimes. Pplware describes this creation as a 'bad' twin of ChatGPT.

sections.heading: Law Enforcement Response
paragraphs: Público reports that the FBI alerted the Polícia Judiciária (PJ) regarding the situation. Pplware notes that the case ended up in the hands of the FBI.
